what: crates/tt/src/lib.rs token_to_literal (~line 530): a quoted literal with a suffix (`'c'u32`, `"s"x`, `b'b'_suff`) becomes LitKind::Err with the whole text; rustc lexes it as Char/Str/Byte with the suffix and refuses the suffix later in the parser/lowering. Check callers that relied on Err for suffixed quoted literals (mbe/proc-macro-srv Display) once built.
